newsitem.title: UK: UK forwarder Air Action names Skivington deputy MD.
newsitem.headline: UK forwarder Air Action names Skivington deputy MD.

text.p: UK forwarder and express freight operator Air Action Group said it has appointed Craig Skivington as deputy managing director.
It added that Skivington has many years of distribution experience with W.H. Smith and will head and co-ordinate various divisions of the group.
The Air Action Group forecast in a statement it would double its 1996 turnover of six million stg within a year to 18 months.
Skivington said he was confident the group was poised for "massive expansion".
"The operation system is working extremely well and by concentrating on sales and marketing, together with acquisitions, our plans are very achievable," he added.
Air Action said it had also given Mike Nordmann responsibility for running the company's domestic and international courier business.
Chris Black becomes responsible for the development of its franchise division. --Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel +44 171 542 7706; fax +5017
